{{Top|leg}}
'''Firecracker mines''' were a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] that could be fired out of a mine launcher. The explosions caused by their launching and detonation gave off intense bursts of light and radiation that flooded [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had its starboard [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] replaced with a mine launcher loaded with sixteen firecracker mines in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. Its [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] crew utilized the mines during a [[mission to the Koornacht Cluster]] to distract the sensor operators of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']], which allowed them to attach the ''Falcon'' to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and enter using a [[hull-cutting ring]]. After rescuing [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the Wookiees launched more mines as they made their escape.
